description: This file is a collection of shell functions and scripts used for managing merge workflows, such as checking mainline drift, verifying merge prerequisites, and executing the merge process for pull requests. It contains functions that interface with git and GitHub to automate and enforce merge policies.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Determines if a given path is part of the mainline drift critical path, based on specific filenames related to project configuration and infrastructure.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Prints a list of files from a given file, with a limit on the number of lines displayed, indicating if more files are present.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Checks whether the mainline has drifted in a way that requires synchronization before merging, by comparing files in the current branch with the main branch.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Performs verification steps before merging a pull request, including checks on PR status, required checks, and potential mainline drift.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Coordinates the entire process of merging a pull request, including verification, preparing commit messages, executing the merge, and cleanup.
